name: refused-uart-serial-two-stop-bits
description: Refusal sample: the serial peer declares an 8n2 frame. The host's driver encodes and decodes 8n1/8e1/8o1 only, so the declaration layer refuses the frame value by name (unsupported-behavior-value:pin_groups.frame) before any model is built.
notes: this scenario exists to record the named refusal, not to pass
the refusal is raised by myfuzz.composition.inprocess_behavior.source_behavior where the frame value is checked
no frame is driven: the declaration is refused before a host exists
